name: Apollo 11 CSM
about: Apollo 11 CSM (1969-059A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1969 Jul 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 Jul 16), held fixed
docked to S04041; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q85753536), noon UTC standing in for the hour; no site given; the point is a stand-in

events.why: landing day from Wikidata; the hour is not given
